# A. Rehman & Sons — Commercial Chemical Supplier & Exporter

> Premier manufacturer and imported chemical supplier in Pakistan since 1988. Specialist in Commercial Laundry, Kitchen & Stewarding, and Institutional Housekeeping Chemical Solutions.

## Quick Facts

- **Export Reach:** Middle East (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman), Central Asia (Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan), and Africa. FOB Karachi Port and CIF sea freight.

## Core Capabilities & Formulations
A. Rehman & Sons manufactures 29 verified commercial chemical formulations with official factory rates:

### 1. Kitchen & Stewarding Range
- **ZEPOL AB** (Rs. 105.00/Kg): Heavy-duty commercial pot & dishwashing detergent. 100% biodegradable.
- **ZEKLOR S** (Rs. 90.00/Kg): Destaining sanitizer for tea urns, ceramic cups, and melamine crockery.
- **DESCALER H3** (Rs. 500.00/Kg): Food-grade acid descaler for commercial dishwashers and bain-maries.
- **OVEN CLEANER** (Rs. 170.00/Kg): Heavy carbon and baked-on grease stripper for commercial rotisseries and grills.
- **GREASE CUTTER** (Rs. 250.00/Kg): Fast-acting industrial solvent degreaser for exhaust hoods and baffle filters.
- **BIO-DETERGENT** (Rs. 150.00/Kg): Multi-enzyme food-waste breakdown detergent for dishwashers and grease traps.
- **T-POL** (Rs. 130.00/Kg): Multi-surface neutral liquid detergent for catering and tableware.

### 2. Commercial Laundry Range
- **ZEPOL SC 10** (Rs. 190.00/Kg): Enzyme-boosted built liquid laundry detergent for blood, protein, and food stains.
- **ZEPOL SC 100** (Rs. 280.00/Kg): Heavy-duty single-shot synthetic detergent liquid for chef coats and heavy soil.
- **ZEKLOR SS** (Rs. 80.00/Kg): Stabilized commercial liquid chlorine bleach for hospital and hotel whites.
- **ZEKLOR O** (Rs. 480.00/Kg): 130-volume oxygen color-safe bleach liquid for colored linens.
- **D-SOUR ZX** (Rs. 120.00/Kg): Liquid laundry sour and anti-chlor neutralizer for the final rinse cycle.
- **SOFTENER CNA** (Rs. 250.00/Kg): Cationic antistatic fabric conditioner with fresh fragrance.
- **SODA ASH** (Rs. 135.00/Kg): Pure sodium carbonate washing builder for water softening.
- **NEEL** (Rs. 500.00/Kg): Ultramarine optical bluing compound for snow-white linen finish.
- **AMROLE** (Rs. 1,500.00/Kg): Textile auxiliary stain lifter for dye-run and cosmetic marks.
- **RUST REMOVER** (Rs. 4,000.00/Kg): Concentrated oxalic acid rust stain eliminator.
- **ZEKLOR HARD** (Rs. 290.00/Kg): Hard water sequestering agent and chelating booster.
- **STARCH** (Rs. 220.00/Kg): Industrial finishing starch for crisp banquet table linen and pillowcases.
- **BLEACH POWDER** (Rs. 135.00/Kg): Calcium hypochlorite powder (65–70% chlorine) for bleaching and disinfection.
- **CAUSTIC SODA** (Rs. 260.00/Kg): Pure sodium hydroxide flakes for heavy saponification of kitchen grease.
- **CITRIC ACID** (Rs. 700.00/Kg): Food-grade organic neutralizer sour and descaler.
- **ZEKLOR DRY** (Rs. 300.00/Kg): Dry laundry compound booster for commercial wash wheels.

### 3. Housekeeping & Facility Care Range
- **CARPET SHAMPOO** (Rs. 260.00/Kg): High-foam dry extraction fiber shampoo for hotel carpets.
- **G.P.C** (Rs. 150.00/Kg): General Purpose Cleaner for marble, tile, vinyl, and walls.
- **HAND CLEANING SHAMPOO** (Rs. 350.00/Kg): Pearlized antibacterial liquid hand soap.
- **LAVATORY / FLOOR CLEANER** (Rs. 150.00/Kg): Germicidal acid toilet and floor cleaner.
- **ZEKLOR CHLORINE** (Rs. 100.00/Kg): Commercial hospital surface disinfectant chlorine.
- **GLASS CLEANER** (Rs. 250.00/Kg): Streak-free mirror and glass polish.
